desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) to compute the initial inversion count of $A$ in $O(N \log M)$.
Precompute the count and sum of 1-based indices for each value $v \in \{0, \dots, M-1\}$ present in $A$.
Iterate $k$ from $0$ to $M-2$, applying the derived delta formula to update the inversion count and store results.
Ensure correct handling of edge cases and verify logic with provided samples.
Enclose the complete solution in the specified format for execution.
